# BTicino C300X Integration v3.0.0b3

## 2026-11-27

Beta. 3.0.0b3 includes everything of **3.0.0b2**, **3.0.0b1** and **2.10.0**.
Everything below is new against 3.0.0b2; the list for 3.0.0b2 is in its
[release notes](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/releases/tag/v3.0.0b2).

The agent update and the live view ran on a Classe 300X with firmware 1.7.19.
Firmware 2.0.2, 3.0.6 and the Classe 100X 1.5.8 are checked offline against
their original files. The Classe 100X support stays **experimental**
([issue #51](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/issues/51)).

## Clean Picture From the First Frame

- Live video starts with a complete picture in the live view, the ring preview
  and an answered call, instead of a grey or broken image until the next full
  frame.

## Door Station Sound

- Two settings under **Configure > Video and audio** replace "Live audio
  level" and "Volume of ring recordings":
  - **Door level** (Stock, +3, +6, +9, +12 dB; default Stock) raises the
    voice at the source. On a Classe 300X this happens in the station's
    audio chip, before the sound is compressed, so it stays clearer than a
    later gain. The station uses the same chip setting for calls answered in
    the BTicino app, so these get louder too. On the Classe 100X the agent
    does it, and the app is not affected.
  - **Fine adjustment** (-10 to +10 dB) adds to the door level.
- Both work the same with Speex and PCMU, in the live view, during a call and
  in ring recordings. Ring recordings now have the same level as the live
  sound.
- The old values are not taken over; the new defaults apply.
- The card plays the sound as it comes and no longer adds its own gain.
- The camera no longer has the attribute `doorstation_audio_gain_db`;
  templates that read it need a change.
- On a Classe 300X a door level above Stock replaces the station's audio
  script; Stock or removing the agent puts the original back.

## Still Unverified on a Device

- The ring preview and an answered call with this beta.
- The door level in the audio chip.
- Everything on a Classe 100X.

## Update and Downgrade

1. Back up Home Assistant and read the beta limitations.
2. Select **3.0.0b3** with Marketplace **Pre-release** or HACS beta versions
   enabled.
3. Complete the agent update Repair: this release includes a rebuilt
   **3.0.0b3** agent.

Before leaving the beta, set **Door level** to **Stock** (or remove the
agent). Leaving the beta then works as described for
[3.0.0b1](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/releases/tag/v3.0.0b1).
